description: Implementation of the android::Rect class, including methods for rectangle manipulation, comparison, transformation, and string representation.

classes.name: Rect
classes.description: Represents a rectangle with methods for manipulation, comparison, and transformation.

methods.name: makeInvalid
methods.description: Sets the rectangle to an invalid state.

methods.name: operator <
methods.description: Comparison operator to determine rectangle ordering.

methods.name: offsetTo
methods.description: Offsets the rectangle to a specific (x, y) position.

methods.name: inset
methods.description: Insets the rectangle by specified amounts.

methods.name: operator +
methods.description: Returns a new rectangle offset by a Point.

methods.name: operator -
methods.description: Returns a new rectangle offset by a Point in the opposite direction.

methods.name: intersect
methods.description: Calculates the intersection with another rectangle.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms the rectangle based on a specified transformation.

methods.name: reduce
methods.description: Reduces the rectangle by excluding a specified rectangle.
